decisions.rationale: 'Tay-Sachs disease' names one specific disease (HEXA-related GM2 gangliosidosis) with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.

'infantile Tay-Sachs disease' is the most specific form of the disease, a single defined disease. The whole string is preferred over the substring 'Tay-Sachs disease' under the minimum necessary span rule.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 5 (Minimum necessary span of text) and 1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: 'TSD' is the abbreviation defined in the parenthetical after 'infantile Tay-Sachs disease' and refers to the same specific disease. Abbreviation definitions are annotated as a separate synonymous mention.

In 'an Italian TSD proband', 'TSD' is a disease name used to modify the noun 'proband' rather than standing alone as a disease mention. Modifier mentions such as 'colorectal cancer families' are annotated as Modifier.
